about: Director-chat replay cases (PLAN.md §6.1 'Prompt hygiene + replay'). Each case is one message to the director on a fixture scene: Harbour Lights Ep 1 scene `scene` (0-based), one shot per script block. Scene 0 is S01 action (wide, kitchen), S02 Nimal's line, S03 action, S04 Kamala's line. `expect.lane` may be a list of acceptable lanes; `expect.ops` must each be contained in some applied operation; `expect.no_ops` means nothing may change; `expect.memory` means a production rule was stored. `rules: true` cases must pass without a model (checked in CI by tests/services/director_chat/test_replay.py); every case is scored with --model. `split` keeps tuning cases apart from held-out ones: change prompts against `tune`, report `heldout`. Do not edit cases to make a change pass.

cases.message: Add a reaction of Kamala after shot 2
How long does the scene run?
Remember: Kamala never cries on screen.
make S04 a close-up and give it 6 seconds
Let shot 4 carry on from shot 3 without a cut
Change Kamala's line to 'sit down and eat'
From now on, every dawn scene opens on a wide.
Can we hold longer on Nimal when he says he's back?
Put a close-up of the frying pan right after the first shot
The radio should be the only sound in shot 3, no music
Make the whole scene feel tenser
Re-plan this entire scene from scratch as a single long take
